The 1985 directive never named software; Directive 2024/2853 makes standalone software, SaaS, AI systems and digital manufacturing files products, subject to strict, no-fault liability; courts can presume defectiveness and causation where a defect is too complex to prove; the liability cannot be waived by a EULA; it applies to products placed on the EU market from 9 December 2026. | small | aside
